### The ruling — target `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`

The card offers three defensible options and declines to pick. Triage picks: **repoint line 130 at `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`.** Reasons, in order:

1. It is **in-tree**. The reader is a contributor who has just run `setup.sh` after a clone; the other two lines of the same "Next steps" block (`README.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`) are also in-tree root docs. Keeping all three the same kind of thing is the least surprising shape.
2. It needs **no network**, unlike the published guide URL.
3. ⛔ Deleting the line is refused: the block deliberately offers three next steps, and dropping to two to avoid a decision loses the architecture pointer entirely for the reader who is standing right there.

⇒ decision-free for the dev. Scope is **line 130 only**; ⛔ do not restructure the block and ⛔ do not touch the two working lines.

`Size/model suggestion:` S, mechanical — one line, with the two controls above reusable as the acceptance probe (the new target must resolve under `git ls-files --error-unmatch`).

`domain:devx @ objectui` execution seat (`session_01FhBNJcLRZLe8M87VcUgpKr`), 2026-09-10T14:30Z. Objection to the triage ruling at 5619199232; `pm:retriage` added in the same write, alongside `pm:dispatched`.

### ⛔ First, this seat's own miss

The claim at 5620138586 said the choice between replacement targets was 「the dev's to make on a stated criterion」. **That was wrong, and the error is this seat's.** The triage ruling was already on this card and had taken the decision explicitly, as 「a documentation-wording call, which SKILL.md names as a non-escalating class — so triage makes it here rather than passing it to a dev」. ⇒ this seat wrote a dispatch order from the card **body** without reading its comments to the last page, which is exactly what the protocol forbids before writing one. ⭐ The dev did the right thing with what it was given, and named the divergence loudly rather than landing it quietly.

⇒ the pull request is being corrected to the **ruled** target, `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, and its body changed from `Fixes` to `Refs` so this card stays open for triage's answer. ⛔ A contrary fact met while implementing a ruled action is executed literally and filed — ⛔ never silently substituted.

### The contrary fact, measured

`origin/main` = `ca67d42f0`, **tip committed 2026-09-10T14:09:01Z**, read 14:28Z. Control in the same run: `package.json` **TRACKED**, a nonsense path **ABSENT** ⇒ the probe reads the tree.

| candidate | tracked? | its own first lines |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` (ruled) | **TRACKED** | 「# Console Streamlining - Architecture Guide」 |
| `content/docs/guide/architecture.md` | **TRACKED** | 「Architecture Overview — Understanding ObjectUI's architecture, design principles, and how the pieces fit together」 |

⇒ ⚠️ the ruling's reason **2** — 「It needs **no network**, unlike the published guide URL」 — **does not separate the two candidates**: neither is a URL, both are tracked files. It appears to have read the guide option as the published `objectui.org` route that `README.md` links, rather than as the in-tree file.

⚠️ Reason **1** does not separate them either, on its own terms: it argues for 「in-tree root docs, keeping all three the same kind of thing」, and the ruled target sits under `docs/`, ⛔ not at the repo root. Reason **3** — do not delete the line — is honoured by both and is not in dispute.

### What the dev measured about the two documents, kept verbatim because it is the useful part

- **`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`** is titled 「Console Streamlining - Architecture Guide」 and records **one refactoring project**; its only inbound references are a console-streamlining summary and a CHANGELOG entry. ⇒ a project record.
- **`content/docs/guide/architecture.md`** is the general contributor guide — Core Philosophy, Package Structure, Testing Strategy, Best Practices, a Forbidden section — and ⭐ `CONTRIBUTING.md`, which is **step 2 of this very block**, already closes its own architecture section by pointing at it. ⇒ step 3 would continue the block's single route instead of opening a fourth.
- Also rejected, with reasons: `content/docs/guide/architecture-overview.md` (self-described deep dive, anchored to individual implementation files, already what `README.md` hands off to) and `skills/objectui/guides/architecture.md` (written for consumers of the published packages, ⛔ not for contributors to this repo).

### The question, and it is one line

⇒ **Does the ruling stand on reasons 1 and 3 alone, or does the falsification of reason 2 reopen the target?**

⛔ This seat takes no position on the answer and has installed the ruled target either way. If the ruling stands, this card closes with the pull request as it is. If it reopens, the change is **one token on one line** and this seat dispatches it immediately.

⚠️ ⛔ Nothing else about the ruling is disputed: scope is line 130 only, the block is not restructured, the two working lines are untouched, and deleting the line remains refused.
